mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_resource_share ( id, tenant_id, resource_id, resource_instance_key, target_type, target_id, creator_user_id, parent_share_id, root_share_id, share_depth, status, start_time, expire_time, can_reshare, active_slot, revoke_reason, revoked_by, revoked_at, version, created_at, updated_at, scope_type, folder_path, collection_resource_ids_json) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceInstanceKey}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{creatorUserId}, #{parentShareId}, #{rootShareId}, #{shareDepth}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{expireTime}, #{canReshare}, #{activeSlot}, #{revokeReason}, #{revokedBy}, #{revokedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{scopeType}, #{folderPath}, #{collectionResourceIdsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, resource_id, resource_instance_key, target_type, target_id, creator_user_id, parent_share_id, root_share_id, share_depth, status, start_time, expire_time, can_reshare, active_slot, revoke_reason, revoked_by, revoked_at, version, created_at, updated_at, scope_type, folder_path, collection_resource_ids_json FROM iam_resource_share WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{shareId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_resource_share_operation ( id, tenant_id, share_id, operation_id, version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{shareId}, #{operationId}, #{version}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO iam_resource_share_field ( id, tenant_id, share_id, operation_id, field_id, readable, writable, hidden, mask_strategy_id, version, created_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{shareId}, #{operationId}, #{fieldId}, #{readable}, #{writable}, #{hidden}, #{maskStrategyId}, 0, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, share_id, operation_id, version, created_at FROM iam_resource_share_operation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND share_id = #{shareId} ORDER BY id
SELECT field_id, readable, writable, hidden, mask_strategy_id FROM iam_resource_share_field WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND share_id = #{shareId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} ORDER BY field_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_share_projection_epoch ( id, tenant_id, resource_id, epoch, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{initialEpoch}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE epoch = epoch + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)

INSERT INTO iam_share_security_epoch ( tenant_id, resource_id, expected_epoch, applied_epoch, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{epoch}, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expected_epoch = GREATEST(expected_epoch, VALUES(expected_epoch)), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
